objective.name: sandbox.dsl.structure.create.patch.read
objective.description: Create, patch, and read one local structure before consuming it in a wrapper.

#root.role: Build one local structure from input params, patch it, read it back, then pass committed fields into a wrapper-backed terminal capacity.

effects.local_structure_create: One new local structure descriptor is created.
effects.local_structure_patch: The created structure is revised once by structure.patch.
effects.local_structure_read: The committed structure is read back before terminal consumption.

transformation_contract.morphing: A simple label becomes one terminal wrapper summary after a structure is created, revised, and re-read in the same DSL flow.
invariants: The committed structure patch replaces functional.source_message with patched-source before the structure is read back.
The terminal wrapper consumes the committed structure fields returned by structure.read and the revision returned by structure.patch.
success: The terminal payload exposes summary and ctx_id from sandbox.consume.record.
The resulting summary reflects the patched source_message and the input label carried through structure.read.
failure: The flow fails if structure.create, structure.patch, or structure.read fails before the terminal wrapper call.
The flow fails if the final wrapper cannot consume the committed structure fields.
notes: This scenario validates local structure lifecycle composition and committed readback inside the DSL runtime.
The N7 harness verifies the terminal summary prefix rather than every structure field.
